source_trigger: NRC EN 58200 EOF lost normal and alternate electrical power; backup generator unsuccessful
question: What was the root cause of the alternate generator failure and EOF power unavailability?
minimum_artifacts: root-cause/CAP record, work order, failure-mode analysis, owner, approval/disposition state, hashable artifact
blocks_claim: EOF power failure understood and corrected
next_action: Request CAP/root-cause and repair package from licensee/NRC/ADAMS path

question: Was a 10 CFR 50.73 Licensee Event Report required, submitted, or explicitly determined not required?
minimum_artifacts: LER number or no-LER disposition, ADAMS accession, event report follow-up, regulatory basis, date
next_action: Track ADAMS/NRC reports after the 60-day LER window and document absence if not found

source_trigger: NRC EN 58200 said power anticipated in next few hours, but not restored at notification time
question: When was power restored and when was the EOF declared fully available?
minimum_artifacts: restoral log, facility status notification, maintenance record, authority basis, timestamps

source_trigger: Backup generator could not be established
question: Was the backup/alternate generator repaired and acceptance-tested under load or functional criteria?
minimum_artifacts: repair work order, post-maintenance test, load/functional test result, acceptance criteria, deficiency closure

source_trigger: Compensatory measures established according to EN 58200
question: What compensatory measures were activated, and did they preserve assessment/communications functions?
minimum_artifacts: compensatory procedure, activation checklist, staffing roster, assessment/communications logs, EOF/JIC product timestamps

source_trigger: June 2026 evaluated exercise follows March 2026 EOF power-loss event
question: Was EOF power/recovery/alternate-facility status included in extent-of-play, controller notes, or evaluation scope?
minimum_artifacts: extent-of-play, objective matrix, controller/evaluator notes, preliminary findings, AAR/IP objective disposition
blocks_claim: exercise evaluated EOF-power recovery or degraded operations
next_action: Ask direct June 12 meeting question and request EOP/objective matrix

source_trigger: Loss of emergency assessment capability can have offsite coordination consequences
question: Did offsite OROs know about, drill against, or rely on EOF compensatory status?
minimum_artifacts: state/county controller logs, injects, situation reports, WebEOC/phone/radio logs, JIC records connecting OROs to EOF status
blocks_claim: offsite organizations integrated with EOF contingency
next_action: Request state/county exercise scope and injects

source_trigger: NRC inspection/reporting path may later add findings or closure
question: Did NRC inspection follow-up, quarterly reports, or ADAMS correspondence address EN 58200?
minimum_artifacts: NRC inspection report, ADAMS accession, inspection finding/disposition, corrective action tracking, recurrence-prevention status
blocks_claim: NRC follow-up complete and recurrence controlled
next_action: Track NRC inspection/ADAMS terms EN 58200, EOF power, BVPS March 2026
